dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Wastewater purified in a medium size municipal wastewater treatment plant (capacity class 3), with an average capacity size of 24900 per-captia-equivalents PCE. \nWastewater contains (in kg/m3): NH4-N: 0.0104 (GSD=122.5%); UUID: 8148929b-4543-49a5-bff8-65b0b6e1230d

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Three stage wastewater treatment (mechanical, biological, chemical) including sludge digestion (fermentation) according to the average technology in Switzerland

# Included processes
Infrastructure materials for municipal wastewater treatment plant, transports, dismantling. Land use burdens.
